access_boundary: This record represents the GPT-5 release whose API page identifies gpt-5-2025-08-07 as the fixed snapshot behind the gpt-5 alias; OpenAI's deprecation page lists that snapshot for shutdown on 2026-12-11. ChatGPT, the gpt-5-mini and gpt-5-nano variants, later GPT-5.x releases, and the OpenAI API platform itself are separate service, application, or model boundaries.
strengths: OpenAI documents a dated snapshot that applications can pin instead of relying only on the alias
The deprecation page records an announcement date, shutdown date, and recommended replacement for the snapshot
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation or independent deployment
The only documented snapshot is already scheduled for shutdown, and no independent cloud path is named on the first-party page

evidence.label: Official GPT-5 model, snapshot, modality, and endpoint documentation
